title: Liouville theorem for a Caccioppoli class closed under directional derivatives
statement: Let n, l be natural numbers, 0 < alpha < 1, K >= 0 and C >= 0. Let S be a set of maps R^n -> R^l such that (S1) every V in S is C^1; (S2) for every V in S and v in R^n the map x -> DV(x)v is in S; (S3) for every V in S, rho > 0 and c in R^l, the lower Lebesgue integral over the open ball B_rho(0) of ||DV||^2 is at most (C / rho^2) times the lower Lebesgue integral over B_{2 rho}(0) of |V - c|^2. Let W in S satisfy ||DW(x) - DW(0)|| <= K |x|^alpha for all x. Then DW(x) = DW(0) for every x in R^n.
lean_statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (α K C : ℝ) (S : Set (Rn n → Rn ℓ)) (W : Rn n → Rn ℓ), 0 < α → α < 1 → 0 ≤ K → 0 ≤ C → (∀ V ∈ S, ContDiff ℝ 1 V) → (∀ V ∈ S, ∀ v : Rn n, (fun x => fderiv ℝ V x v) ∈ S) → (∀ V ∈ S, ∀ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ → ∀ c : Rn ℓ, ∫⁻ x in ball (0 : Rn n) ρ, ‖fderiv ℝ V x‖ₑ ^ 2 ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (C / ρ ^ 2) * ∫⁻ x in ball (0 : Rn n) (2 * ρ), ‖V x - c‖ₑ ^ 2) → W ∈ S → (∀ x : Rn n, ‖fderiv ℝ W x - fderiv ℝ W 0‖ ≤ K * ‖x‖ ^ α) → ∀ x : Rn n, fderiv ℝ W x = fderiv ℝ W 0
